summary.en: Arche Fund (rebranded from Coin98 Ventures in Aug 2023) is the venture arm of Vietnamese Web3 coalition Ninety Eight (creator of Coin98). It manages a US$25M ecosystem fund (launched Nov 2023) supporting early-stage Web3 startups across Asia, offering capital and access to the Viction layer-1 blockchain, and runs the Kompass accelerator.
